# Validate portable book configuration and ordering

Read root AGENTS.md and README.md first. Keep work local unless release is explicitly requested.

1. Use a disposable vault with multiple first-level books and an unscoped root note. Preserve arbitrary existing frontmatter and note bodies.
2. Exercise one-time root `index.md` startup with a file, book folder, invalid path, saved workspace, empty book, and reset Boolean.
3. Verify the sort menu offers only alphabetical, creation-date and properties, with independent direction control. Same-directory Previous/Next links win; cross-folder links are ignored. Test date substrings, maintained creation timestamps, filesystem fallback and names, stable descending reversal, inherited folder overrides and cyclic links. Confirm no manual file drag mode or fileOrder generation.
4. Verify exact anchored ignore paths, escaped special names, removal without losing other rules, empty/fully hidden books and session-only reveal.
5. Verify automatic colors/overrides, `book-tabs-` aliases and plain-key collision preservation, reset preservation, config renames with collision and rollback checks, and all frontmatter commands in main/pop-out views.
6. Check right-of-current/end tabs and row-major Grid, then overflow through all configured base cells. Long-press regrouping and increased row/column settings must refill that Grid and return managed pop-outs while preserving explicit free-window ownership.
7. Verify index-move blocking and each transfer strategy, the checked excluded-folder count action plus usable native sliding tree menus, inherited Markdown/Canvas/Base templates with a shared global/local date field and legacy mapping migration, relative subtree exclusions, exact book-relative destination previews, automatic link updating, and duplicate-tab removal during regrouping. Test primary/secondary empty-book creation controls through focus changes, actual subfolder-note underline, book rename/alias/title synchronization, root alias stability with no folder-order metadata, all frontmatter display modes, optional companion-plugin key synchronization, recursive Article Navigator generation/population, exact conflict review and recalculated blacklist exclusions, and persistent missing-link card dismissal/restoration.
8. Run npm ci, npm test, npm run build, npm run lint. Test single-folder inert routing. Record actual evidence and unresolved checks; do not infer live success from compilation.

Verify dedicated book-tabs sections, idempotent migration of owned legacy duplicates, preserved unrelated data and body bytes, stable key order, malformed-section rejection, selected-field regeneration, backed-up frontmatter deletion, and startup with regeneration paused. Match article creation cards to Article Navigator default inline spacing and placement in reading and editing views.
